source_extracts.label: Priority Mail page
source_extracts.quote: Priority Mail® service includes tracking and delivery in 2-3 days. Check delivery time estimates with the USPS Service Standards Map. ... Prices start at $11.50 at a Post Office. ... Includes USPS Tracking® and up to $100 of insurance with most shipments (restrictions apply). ... No surcharges for fuel; residential or rural delivery; or Saturday delivery. ... Maximum weight is 70 lbs. ... Maximum combined length and girth (girth is the distance around the thickest part) is 108 inches.

source_extracts.label: Priority Mail page disclaimer 1
source_extracts.quote: In most cases, the expected delivery date printed on your receipt or provided at checkout will reflect a delivery time of 2-3 days and is based on origin, destination, and drop-off time. The expected delivery date does not come with a money-back guarantee.

source_extracts.label: Priority Mail nonstandard fees
source_extracts.quote: Between 22 and 30 inches long: add $4.50; More than 30 inches long: add $21.00; More than 2 cubic feet (3,456 cubic inches): add $35.00; A nonstandard shape or material: add $4.50 ... USPS Flat Rate packaging is exempt from all Nonstandard Fees ... HAZMAT Handling Fee: If you're sending Hazardous Materials (HAZMAT), you'll need to pay an extra $7.50 handling fee.

source_extracts.label: Priority Mail Express page
source_extracts.quote: Priority Mail Express® service provides 1–3 day delivery service by 6 PM with a money–back guarantee. You get competitive prices and fast delivery every day, all year, with limited exceptions, to most U.S. addresses and PO Boxes™. ... Prices start at $37.05 at a Post Office. ... Fastest delivery times: 1–3 days with a money-back guarantee; Sunday and holiday delivery available in many major markets for an additional fee; Includes USPS Tracking® and up to $100 of insurance with most shipments; Price includes proof of delivery signature record (if requested at time of purchase).

source_extracts.label: PME Flat Rate Envelope pricing
source_extracts.quote: Flat Rate Envelope: $33.46 Commercial Pricing / $38.25 at Post Office ... Legal Flat Rate Envelope: $33.78 / $38.55 ... Padded Flat Rate Envelope: $34.05 / $39.25

source_extracts.label: Mail & Shipping Services comparison page
source_extracts.quote: Our fastest domestic shipping service, Priority Mail Express® delivers 7 days a week, 365 days a year (with limited exceptions). 1-3 day delivery is available to most U.S. addresses and PO Box™ addresses with a money-back guarantee. ... Up to $100 insurance included; you can buy additional insurance coverage up to $5,000. ... Priority Mail® is our bestselling mail service. Domestic deliveries arrive in 2-3 days depending on where your package starts and where it's going. Tracking and insurance are included, shipping boxes and envelopes are free.

source_extracts.label: DMM 113 (refund window, 6 PM)
source_extracts.quote: Items are delivered by 6 p.m. on the scheduled delivery day. ... Priority Mail Express is an expedited service for shipping any mailable matter, with a money-back guarantee.

scope_rules.rule: Never call Priority Mail's 2-3 day estimate a guarantee; USPS states explicitly there is no money-back guarantee on Priority Mail.
The Express money-back guarantee has exceptions; qualify with 'with limited exceptions' and note the 30-day refund request window rather than promising automatic refunds.
Never state Express delivers to ALL PO Boxes — USPS says 'most U.S. addresses and PO Boxes'.
Never state our store prices for Priority Mail or Express postage; all prices cited are USPS retail starting prices, and the reader is told to check the counter for their actual quote.
scope_rules.reason: store pricing varies by weight/zone and Frank has not approved counter price claims

scope_rules.rule: Never promise Express delivery 'overnight' — the guaranteed range is 1-3 days depending on origin/destination.

when the guaranteed date/time on the receipt is missed; refund request within 30 days
